steps.step1: Use your Minecraft client to connect to Hypixel.
steps.step2: Once connected, and while in the lobby, right click "My Profile" in your hotbar. It is option #2.
steps.step3: Click "Social Media" - this button is to the left of the Redstone block (the Status button).
steps.step4: Click "Discord" - it is the second last option.
steps.step5: Paste your Discord username into chat and hit enter. For reference: `{username}`
steps.step6: You're done! Wait around 30 seconds and then try again.
